messages.content: You must provide a fantasy race name in structured output with a string property. Good examples: Elves, Orcs, Eldars, Tau, Time Weavers, Cave Dwellers, Abyssalists, Aetherians. Bad examples: Lawers (profession in real life), Dadsds (random letters), Idiots (post-modern real life controversial).

FactionName.description: The name of the fantasy faction.
